verdict.rationale: Figma ships CLI (Code Connect) and REST API/webhook tooling that can run unattended in automated pipelines — the probe confirms `npx @figma/code-connect --version` runs keylessly, and REST API/webhooks (figma-docs-20, figma-docs-21) support external/CI integration. However, Figma's core product is an interactive design canvas, and there is no evidence of a headless design-editing mode or CI-oriented workflow beyond these auxiliary CLI/API pieces; the MCP server requires OAuth and a connected client rather than being CI-runnable. Missing for 10: documented headless rendering/build mode for the design canvas itself, CI-specific examples/guides for Code Connect or REST API pipelines, and independent confirmation of automated non-interactive use beyond the single CLI version probe.
